note: The Bahamas, read on the Department of Immigration's own pages on 2026-10-30. A non-Bahamian working and living there beyond 90 days needs a work permit; the annual work permit (a year, as named, renewed: the page speaks of renewals) costs a BSD 200 non-refundable processing fee (kept) on top of the fee of its Immigration Fee Scale, which isn't read; the employer's or sponsor's papers go with it (read as work for the sponsor, applied for before arrival). Permanent residence is open, among other categories, to one who has held legal work permit status for more than twenty consecutive years (20 kept), with a BSD 200 processing fee. Naturalisation's years weren't read.

sources.title: Department of Immigration (Bahamas), Annual Work Permit
sources.said: Non-Bahamian nationals, who are desirous of working and living in The Bahamas for a period greater than 90 days, must first be authorized to do so by way of a valid work permit issued by the Department of Immigration. ... Annual Work Permit Application Requirements: $200.00 non-refundable processing fee ... Copy of biographical data page of Employer/Sponsor’s current passport ... whether for new permits or renewals

sources.title: Department of Immigration (Bahamas), Permanent Residence
sources.said: Persons who have held legal work permit status for more than twenty (20) consecutive years . ... Certificate of Permanent Residence Application Requirements: $200.00 non-refundable processing fee
